digest.component_or_area: test instrumentation and macOS editor server setup
propositions: Gerrit Verify runs consistently report ~35 second setup duration for test_server_binds_loopback_only, with focused test runs and targeted instrumentation showing sub-second/millisecond performance, indicating a long pole in CI only.

CPython ThreadingHTTPServer construction synchronously calls socket.getfqdn on numeric loopback 127.0.0.1, triggering reverse DNS lookup and creating a fixed macOS resolver timeout as the leading hypothesis for the 35-second delay.

Instrumentation must measure nested fixture setup spans (fixture setup observer, editor server constructor, TCP bind, socket.getfqdn) independently and emit only operations exceeding 1 second threshold, armed by CI or REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1.

Organic post-merge Gerrit Verify run 31846417650 on macOS confirmed socket.getfqdn elapsed=35.013s and ThreadingHTTPServer constructor elapsed=35.014s, eliminating TCP bind, tmp_path, and worker starvation hypotheses.
